decisions.summary: Analyze actor/rule/use-specific draft applicability while retaining evidence uncertainty.
decisions.concern: Avoid inventory-label roles, global exemptions, blanket December deferral or invented approval.
options: Combine enacted provisions with recorded operating facts and scoped uncertainty
Treat inventory labels, old questionnaires or human review as settling applicability
decisions.chosen_behavior: Separate company and product-provider duties, policy observations, evidence states and conditional timing.
decisions.rationale: Recorded product market entry and role facts have different meanings from content publication, inventory names or evidence completeness.
tradeoffs: Useful scoped draft exclusions and triggers remain subject to manual provenance and Legal review; they are not final compliance findings.
decisions.downstream_effect: Later actions/approval work must preserve conflicts and resolve the specific reviewer questions without using draft timing as an operational deadline.
